title: Beaver Meadows Recreational Area Campground

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: 57 family campsites, two double sites, and one group site, each containing a picnic table(s), fire ring, and grassy tent site. There are showers, flush toilets, a pressurized water system, and a dump station. 20 campsites; 5.2-mile hike. The closest boat launch is Roper Hollow. Facilities include a table; fire ring-no grill, vault (Sweet Smelling) toilets and hand pump for water. 3 mile drive down a dirt road. Not recommended for large boats. It has a launch with no dock, there is a restroom and shoreline trails. Access by boat or hike only. Closest boat launches are Willow Bay and Webbs Ferry. blurb: Beaver Meadows, noted for its beautiful pine overstory, offers 38 campsites in a serene setting. Each campsite has a large parking spur, tent pad, fire ring, and picnic table. Parking spurs are level and designed for travel trailer use (no hookups). Vault toilets and hand pumps are available. No Dump Station. A small picnic area (eight units) overlooks the lake.
